name: Palace Hotel Tokyo
insider_take: This imperial palace neighbor perfectly balances Japanese elegance with European grandeur in the heart of Tokyo's financial district.
whats_special: Palace Hotel Tokyo sits on the former site of the historic Tokyu Hotel and offers unparalleled views of the Imperial Palace East Gardens and moat. The hotel's Crown restaurant holds three Michelin stars, making it one of only a handful of hotel restaurants in Japan with this prestigious rating. The property features original artwork throughout, including pieces specifically commissioned for the hotel's 2012 renovation.
pro_tip: Book a Palace Side room for direct views of the Imperial Palace grounds – especially stunning during cherry blossom season in spring and autumn foliage season.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps from Tokyo Station (3-minute walk) for easy bullet train access, while the Imperial Palace East Gardens offer a peaceful escape from city energy. The nearby Marunouchi district features luxury shopping and the historic Tokyo Station's beautiful red-brick facade, fully restored to its 1914 design.
pros: Prime location directly overlooking Imperial Palace East Gardens
Exceptional Japanese hospitality and white-glove service standards
Luxurious spa and fitness facilities with panoramic city views
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
